Here are the technical specifications for the latest MacBook Air (13-inch and 15-inch models with the Apple M5 chip) found on Apple's website:

---

### **Overview & Models**
- **Sizes Available:** 13-inch (13.6-inch display) and 15-inch (15.3-inch display)
- **Finishes:** Sky Blue, Silver, Starlight, Midnight

---

### **Processor / Chip (Apple M5)**
- **CPU:** 10-core CPU with 4 super cores and 6 efficiency cores
- **GPU:** 
  - 13-inch base model: 8-core GPU (configurable to 10-core GPU)
  - 13-inch higher tiers & all 15-inch models: 10-core GPU
- **Features:** Neural Accelerators, hardware-accelerated ray tracing, 16-core Neural Engine, 153GB/s memory bandwidth
- **Media Engine:** Hardware-accelerated H.264, HEVC, ProRes, ProRes RAW, AV1 decode; dedicated video decode, video encode, and ProRes encode/decode engines

---

### **Memory (Unified Memory)**
- **Standard Configurations:** 16GB or 24GB unified memory
- **Configurable To:** 24GB or 32GB unified memory

---

### **Storage**
- **Standard Configurations:** 512GB SSD or 1TB SSD
- **Configurable To:** 1TB, 2TB, or 4TB SSD

---

### **Display**
- **Display Type:** Liquid Retina display, LED-backlit with IPS technology, 500 nits brightness, Wide color (P3), True Tone technology, support for 1 billion colors
- **13-inch:**
  - 13.6-inch diagonal
  - 2560-by-1664 native resolution at 224 pixels per inch
- **15-inch:**
  - 15.3-inch diagonal
  - 2880-by-1864 native resolution at 224 pixels per inch

---

### **Battery & Power**
- **Battery Life:** Up to 18 hours video streaming; up to 15 hours wireless web
- **Battery Capacity:**
  - 13-inch: Built-in 53.8-watt-hour lithium-polymer battery
  - 15-inch: Built-in 66.5-watt-hour lithium-polymer battery
- **Charging:**
  - Included: 40W Dynamic Power Adapter with 60W Max and USB-C to MagSafe 3 Cable (2 m)
  - Fast-charge capable with 70W or higher USB PD power source

---

### **Ports & Expansion**
- MagSafe 3 charging port
- 3.5 mm headphone jack (advanced support for high-impedance headphones)
- Two Thunderbolt 4 (USB-C) ports supporting:
  - Charging
  - DisplayPort (native DisplayPort 1.4 speeds up to HBR3 with DSC capability)
  - Thunderbolt 4 (up to 40Gb/s)
  - USB 4 (up to 40Gb/s)

---

### **External Display Support**
- Supports up to two external displays:
  - Two displays up to 6K at 60Hz or 4K at 144Hz
  - One display up to 8K at 60Hz, 5K at 120Hz, or 4K at 240Hz
- Supports up to two external displays over a single Thunderbolt port
- Simultaneously supports the built-in display at full native resolution

---

### **Camera & Audio**
- **Camera:** 12MP Center Stage camera with support for Desk View; 1080p HD video recording; advanced ISP with computational video
- **Audio:**
  - 13-inch: Four-speaker sound system
  - 15-inch: Six-speaker sound system with force-cancelling woofers
  - Both: Spatial Audio support with Dolby Atmos, three-mic array with directional beamforming, Voice Isolation and Wide Spectrum microphone modes

---

### **Wireless Connectivity**
- Apple N1 wireless networking chip
- Wi-Fi 7 (802.11be)
- Bluetooth 6
- Thread networking technology

---

### **Keyboard & Trackpad**
- Backlit Magic Keyboard with 12 full-height function keys, Touch ID, and ambient light sensor
- Force Touch trackpad supporting pressure-sensing, Force clicks, accelerators, and Multi-Touch gestures

---

### **Size & Weight**
- **13-inch:**
  - Height: 0.44 inch (1.13 cm)
  - Width: 11.97 inches (30.41 cm)
  - Depth: 8.46 inches (21.5 cm)
  - Weight: 2.7 pounds (1.23 kg)
- **15-inch:**
  - Height: 0.45 inch (1.15 cm)
  - Width: 13.40 inches (34.04 cm)
  - Depth: 9.35 inches (23.76 cm)
  - Weight: 3.3 pounds (1.51 kg)
